contribution.position: Unchanged: artifact:test-report and artifact:perf-report are clean, but artifact:incident-log shows last quarter's two sev2s were both retry storms, and nothing exercises the rebuild under those failure conditions or shows it alters retry behavior. I also note artifact:ops-runbook states no rollback rehearsal has been run, which undercuts the ops claim of a proven rollback path. Reliability still needs targeted evidence before confidence is warranted.
